# betterado_serviceendpoint_generic_git (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)
- `repository_url` (String) The server URL of the GenericGit git service connection.
- `service_endpoint_name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `enable_pipelines_access` (Boolean) A value indicating whether or not to attempt accessing this git server from Azure Pipelines.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password or token key to use for the GenericGit git service connection.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `username` (String) The username to use for the GenericGit service git connection.

### Read-Only

- `authorization` (Map of String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
